messages:
nina: Heads-up: CS flagged a few new users who couldn't handle errors from our JS quickstart. They got `Error: Bad request` with no actionable info. Go SDK gave a structured `InvalidArgument` error. We need parity and clearer onboarding snippets.
tim: Ack. We promised typed exceptions across SDKs. Looks like quickstart still demonstrates raw HTTP `message` checks. That confuses folks.
alex: I dug into the JS SDK: it currently creates a single Error with `message = body.message || response.statusText`. No code/hint props.
frank: That's rough for user DX. Suggestion: JS should construct classes like `class InvalidArgumentError extends RedwoodError { constructor(props){ super(props.human_message); this.code = props.code; this.hint = props.hint } }` and set `err.httpStatus`.
sophia: Also streaming cases are tricky: we don't always get a JSON body on socket close. Can we standardize on a trailing HTTP/1.1 header `x-rwin-error` or include a final newline-delimited JSON chunk with the envelope? Either way, SDKs should fall back to status code -> code mapping when body is unavailable.
nina: For docs, let's publish a minimal wire contract snippet and an example quickstart block (JS + Go). Keep it short so people copy-paste.

Example canonical envelope (compact):
```json
{"code":"InvalidArgument","human_message":"prompt exceeds 8k tokens","hint":"shorten or use summarization","http_status":400}
```

JS usage example we want in quickstart:
```js
try {
  await client.generate(...)
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof InvalidArgumentError) {
    // show short user-friendly text
    showToast(err.human_message)
  } else if (err instanceof RateLimitError) {
    setRetryAfter(err.retryAfter)
  } else {
    logger.error(err)
  }
}
```

alex: Nice. For the mapping table in the error docs, propose we express it as canonical code names (not SDK exception names):
- 400 -> InvalidArgument
- 401 -> AuthenticationFailed
- 403 -> PermissionDenied
- 404 -> ResourceNotFound
- 409 -> Conflict
- 422 -> InvalidState
- 429 -> RateLimit (include `retry_after` seconds)
- 500..599 -> ServerError (retriable; may include `retry_after`)

frank: We should also include a small compatibility helper in JS: `wrapLegacyError(body, status)` which builds the envelope if the server returned just a `message` string. Keep it for one major release.
sophia: Test plan: add an integration test in sampleapp CI that POSTs an overly long prompt to staging and asserts `err.code === 'InvalidArgument' && typeof err.human_message === 'string'`. Add another test that simulates a streaming error with only a status and ensures SDK maps to `ServerError` or specific code.
nina: Owners: alex -> JS SDK PR (error classes + compat), tim -> quickstart/doc updates, frank -> sampleapp changes + CI tests, sophia -> streaming header/trailer proposal and edge-case tests. ETA: small fixes by Thu, docs + sampleapp by next Tue.

devex-bot: Created task RDW-7895 "SDK error parity & onboarding fixes" assigned: alex, tim, frank. https://github.com/redwood/devex/issues/7895

frank: One more UX rule: `human_message` should be <= 140 chars, no stack traces, and must include suggested next steps when possible.

alex: I'll add a lint rule to js-sdk that errors if constructed RedwoodError lacks `code` and `human_message`. Also add changelog note for JS consumers.
sophia: For streaming we'll add `x-rw-error: 1` and a final JSON trailer when possible; otherwise fall back to `http_status` mapping. I'll open the API PR.
tim: Great. CS follow-up: nina, can you ask CS to validate fixed tickets after deploy?
nina: Yep, will coordinate and provide checklist to CS.

sophia: PRs incoming today. I'll post links here when ready. :rocket:
